supersession_reason: The unchanged July protocol stopped at its blinded sample gate with only one month of temporal coverage. This pre-unblinding amendment requires six contiguous months to address inadequate temporal coverage and statistical power. No Chainlink feature/outcome relationship was inspected before this amendment was locked.

amendment.reason: inadequate temporal coverage and statistical power
amendment.only_substantive_change: minimum contiguous observation horizon increased from one complete calendar month to six complete contiguous calendar months

primary_question: At the time of a breakout decision, does causally known Chainlink ETH/USD reference-price state improve the ability to distinguish successful breakouts from failed breakouts beyond existing venue-price, return, volatility, and breakout-structure information?
primary_null: After controlling for existing venue and breakout information, causally available Chainlink ETH/USD features provide no meaningful incremental association with breakout outcomes.

population.selection_rationale: The original immutable July study stopped before Chainlink/outcome inspection because its blinded population failed temporal and event floors. This amendment extends the left boundary to six fixed contiguous complete calendar months while preserving the accepted raw Market Profile balance_breakout definition, fixed 30-minute runtime input, eligibility rules, and right boundary. The new interval was fixed before inspecting any Chainlink relationship or the February-June breakout population.

breakout_definition.logic: previous_location == inside_value and current_location transitions above_value or below_value

outcomes.invalidation: first close within 12 bars that returns through the event VAH for long or VAL for short

include: raw balance_breakout event known at a study-window bar close
eligibility.chainlink_primary_complete_case: latest causally known value exists and age_seconds <= 21600
eligibility.missing_data_policy: Never future-fill. Baseline-versus-enriched comparison uses the same Chainlink-primary-complete events; missing and stale events remain counted and reported.
eligibility.cluster_policy: Retain all eligible raw breakouts but perform uncertainty resampling by UTC calendar-day blocks and report per-day concentration.

temporal_evaluation.fold_schedule_rationale: The locked three-fold expanding calendar-time structure, 12-bar purge, and 12-bar embargo are unchanged. The six-month amendment fixes an initial three-calendar-month training span followed by three consecutive one-calendar-month validation spans, with the unchanged six-hour purge between each training cutoff and validation start. This calendar schedule was locked before inspecting the extended event population.

statistical_methods.baseline_model: standardized L2 logistic regression with C=1.0 and fixed random_state=20260807
statistical_methods.enriched_model: the identical baseline model plus every predeclared Chainlink feature
secondary_metrics: paired delta_roc_auc when both classes are present
success rates by predeclared feature bins
direct effect sizes for 6-bar signed forward return
statistical_methods.uncertainty: paired UTC-day block bootstrap with 2000 replicates, 95% percentile intervals, seed 20260807
statistical_methods.multiple_comparison_method: Holm adjustment across the eight predeclared direct Chainlink feature tests
statistical_methods.feature_bins: fixed pooled-sample quartiles with ties collapsed; no outcome-guided cut points

decision_rules.incremental_signal_supported: All minimum sample rules pass; aggregate paired delta_log_loss >= 0.005; its 95% block-bootstrap lower bound is > 0; and delta_log_loss is positive in at least two of three valid temporal folds.
decision_rules.no_incremental_signal_found: All minimum sample rules pass; the 95% block-bootstrap upper bound for paired delta_log_loss is < 0.005; and no direct Chainlink feature survives Holm adjustment with a practically material effect.
decision_rules.insufficient_evidence: Any minimum sample rule fails, fewer than two temporal folds are valid, material causal coverage is missing, or uncertainty overlaps both the supported and negative-result regions.

holdout_policy: No sealed holdout is opened or claimed. This is exploratory S0/S1 report evidence only and cannot certify or promote a strategy.
